title: Apply for a Letter of Overseas Assessment (registered surveyor)
summary: Overseas qualified surveyors can apply to practice surveying in NSW by applying for a Letter of Overseas Assessment through the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).
intro:
If you're a qualified surveyor from overseas, you can apply to practise surveying in NSW through the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).

BOSSI will forward your application to the Bureau for Assessment of Overseas Qualifications (Reciprocating Surveyors Boards of Australia and New Zealand). The Bureau will independently assess your qualification and make a recommendation to BOSSI.

You may:
who_can_apply: Must hold surveying qualifications gained outside Australia or New Zealand.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or OneGov account.
Supporting documents (e.g., curriculum vitae, evidence of relevant experience).
A credit/debit card to pay the application fee.
All documents must be certified, in English, and in PDF format.

how_to_steps.text: Gather your supporting documents and information.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or log in using your OneGov account.
Follow the prompts to proceed to payment.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this assessment?
faqs.a: You must hold surveying qualifications that were gained outside of Australia or New Zealand.

faqs.q: What is the first step in the application process?
faqs.a: Gather all your supporting documents and necessary information.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the assessment?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button, proceed through the application screens, and log in or create a MyServiceNSW Account.
